Merchandise trade export shares and annual growth across destination markets and product sectors, 2021-2023

The National Directorate of Trade Statistics collected monthly merchandise customs export summaries from January 2021 through December 2023 to track structural reallocation in export baskets across partner markets and strategic commodity groups.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `broad_sector` | category | Manufactures, Agriculture & Food, Mining & Energy; group product |
| `export_share` | measure | unit percent; non-additive |
| `export_value_usd` | measure | unit million USD; additive |
| `partner_country` | category | China, Japan, South Korea, United States, Canada, Germany, France; within trading_bloc; group geography |
| `product_group` | category | Machinery & Electronics, Automotive & Transport, Chemicals & Plastics, Grains & Oilseeds, Processed Foods & Beverages, Metal Ores & Minerals, Refined Petroleum; within broad_sector; group product |
| `quarter` | category | 2021-Q1, 2021-Q2, 2021-Q3, 2021-Q4, 2022-Q1, 2022-Q2, 2022-Q3, 2022-Q4, 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4; ordered=ordinal; derived from report_month; group calendar |
| `report_month` | time | 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `trading_bloc` | category | Asia-Pacific, North America, European Union; group geography |
| `yoy_share_change` | measure | unit percentage points; non-additive |
